turns.customer: Boarding my cat Luna Jan 12-15 2027. She has her rabies shot. Is that all she needs?
blocks:
According to Happy Tails Pet Resort’s Cedar Park requirements, cats need **current rabies and feline distemper combination (FVRCP) vaccinations**. So rabies alone may not be enough; they also require written proof from your veterinary clinic. The resort recommends giving vaccinations about two weeks before boarding. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/vaccination-requirements-policies))

Please confirm Luna’s records are current for **January 12–15, 2027**, and check directly with the resort for any updated requirements. I can’t verify availability or make a reservation.
